Frequently asked questions

Is this class for beginners or intermediate animators?

Both. These are challenges every animator runs into early, and they keep slowing people down until they’re solved properly.

Is this class for Maya, Blender or Unreal?

Demos are in Maya, but most of the material carries over to Blender and Unreal. Some buttons and features differ; the ideas still apply.

Are the exercises mandatory?

No. They’re small puzzles, about 15 to 60 minutes each, just for practice.

How long will I have access?

Forever. It’s a one-time purchase, and the recordings never expire.

Can I get feedback on my shots?

The class is pre-recorded. For personal notes and drawovers on your work, book a Mentorship Dailies session.
